description: Navigate to the next and previous pages of a website using keyboard shortcuts.
click_to_register: Click a page number button to register.
url_pattern_help_content:
Guesses the "next page" based on numeric clues in the URL and navigates to it.

(\d+) within the regular expression is treated as the page number.

Registering a URL pattern enables smooth page navigation even on sites where the default behavior fails.
